title: The integral system pullback square is exactly localized
statement: For a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell, a scheme map j:U→X, endomorphisms gU:U→U and gX:X→X with gU j = j gX, the word of the two specified integralComparisonSystemComposition isomorphisms and equality transport equals mapDerivedCategorySquareIso of the ordinary varying-ring moduleSquareG at the lifted quotient coefficient rings. This asserts equality of the specified natural isomorphisms on the ordinary unbounded derived categories of whole strict systems; no open or Cartesian hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Tags 0D6D and 03D3; Zheng 4.10, exact localization of composition and equality transport.

proof.text: Apply the existing exact square-localization identity system_square_localization from the intrinsic/varying-ring mate normalization: mapDerivedCategorySquareIso(moduleSquareG) is the corresponding word of gComp and equality transport.

Rewrite both integral compositors by integralComparisonSystemComposition_eq_varyingRing. The remaining transport between the same derived inverse-image functors agrees definitionally, proving equality of the isomorphism words.

lean.statement:
theorem integralComparisonSystemSquare_eq_varyingRing
    {U X : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ X) (gU : U ⟶ U) (gX : X ⟶ X)
    (h : gU ≫ j = j ≫ gX) :
    (integralComparisonSystemComposition l E j gX).symm ≪≫
        eqToIso (congrArg (integralComparisonDerivedSequencePullback l E) h.symm) ≪≫
        integralComparisonSystemComposition l E gU j =
      Functor.mapDerivedCategorySquareIso
        (ProEtale.VaryingRing.moduleSquareG
          (fun n ↦ CommRingCat.of (ULift.{u + 1}
            (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))))
          (fun n ↦ CommRingCat.ofHom
            (Padic.coefficientExtensionTransition l E (n + 1)).ulift) gU j j gX h)
